facts.text: Andrew plans to bring binoculars and a notebook to log birds during the trip.

evidence.quote: I'll bring my binos and a notebook to log them at the trip.

facts.text: Andrew has experience with birdwatching and has read books about ecological systems.

evidence.quote: Like I said I do enjoy watching birds in the nature. I also read some books about our ecological systems as well.

facts.text: Andrew has learned about animals, plants, and ecosystems and finds it fascinating how they are interconnected.

evidence.quote: I learned a lot about animals, plants, and ecosystems. It's fascinating to see how it all works together.
